name: prism-ledger
description: Prism Ledger is the money core of a wallet, marketplace or payments company. Every movement is a journal of debit and credit legs that must balance per currency, and it is validated in full before anything is applied, so a journal either lands completely or not at all. Idempotency keys turn client retries into safe replays, and a key reused with a different payload is a 409 conflict. Holds reserve funds for card authorisations and withdrawals, then capture all or part of them. Each tenant has isolated accounts and its own SHA-256 hash chain: editing, deleting or reordering any journal is detected, and a Merkle root over all chains can be published as an external anchor. A reconciliation engine matches expected cash movements against bank statements by reference, by amount and date, net of fees, and as many-to-one settlement batches (using a bounded subset sum). Anything left over becomes a categorised break.
author: Soumya Bhandare (krishyaa06)
